This table details covered perils under a Harel Insurance Company marine hull policy for yachts and boats. It lists events that may cause loss or damage, and are covered by the insurance.

capture,  seizure,  arrest,  restraint  or  detainment  (barratry and piracy excepted), and the consequences thereof or any attempt thereat.
